Frequently Asked Questions

How do I find a verified lawyer in Hyderabad?

Post your case requirements on LitigaForge and our AI matches you with the top 10 verified advocates in Hyderabad with match scores and plain-language explanations.

Is LitigaForge AI free?

Yes. Legal Q&A, document analysis, judgment search, free legal aid finder, and the advocate directory are free. Professional (₹999/month) and Advocate Pro (₹2,499/month) plans unlock unlimited credits.

Who is eligible for free legal aid in Andhra Pradesh?

Women, SC/ST individuals, persons with disabilities, trafficking victims, persons in custody, and those with annual income below ₹3 lakhs are eligible under the Legal Services Authorities Act.

Can I analyze a legal document online?

Yes. Paste your document into the Document Analyzer to get an AI risk score, missing-clause detection, and recommendations — instantly and free.
